main_body: Flat green grass ground patch tiled with repeating dark/light clumps; no standing volume
evidence: The candidate is a flat grass terrain tile. It has no standing body, so the top/front 3/4 contract does not apply. A terrain kind is treated as a ground texture and does not fail the 3/4 check.

style.evidence: The grass has a mid green base with light-green speckles and dark-green clumps, roughly 4 tones. The clumps repeat on an obvious regular grid every 16px, which gives a mechanical tiling look. Between the clumps there are large flat areas of one green, roughly 8x8 px or more, with no grain. The Beodeul grass reference has more varied tufts and soil grain, so the candidate is thinner and its tiles carry fewer colours.
